subject: A frontal, symmetrical head-and-shoulders bust, eyes closed, plain carved-wood face, in a grainy grey-brown mail coif and broad mail shoulders reaching both edges, brown leather straps, no white cloth; on the brow a head-wide gold sun-wheel, dark-blue jewel, pale-blue rays; all mid-tone sepia.

A slim soldier striding left to right, seen from the side, his whole body dark cool blue-grey with navy shadows, no glow round him, on a thick band of choppy water spanning almost the full width: dozens of crisp, sharp-edged navy, teal and cyan wavelets, white-crested, shin-high; no shore.

A slim soldier facing us in a wide braced stance, a long sword held diagonally across his whole body, point beyond his head at upper left; mail, tabard, skin and boots all rust-orange and copper, no grey or white; round him, touching nowhere, a thin white chalk loop a head's width out, plain background between.

Electric sparks and nothing else, wider than tall: from a white-hot core in a pale-cyan glow, left of centre, fifteen thin crooked forking streaks of uneven length, the longest to the top-left corner and right edge, the lower right nearly empty; mid-tone slate-teal edges, pale-cyan centres, a white-cyan spark at each tip; no person.

A compass star of light and nothing else: four long hair-thin rays up, down, left and right almost to the edges, four shorter diagonals, meeting in a bright point; each a crisp flat blade of pale silver edged lavender-pink; behind it a soft cream-white glow over most of the picture, fading out before the edges; no arrow.
